code.contract: Implement append_once(path,record) using stdlib on local POSIX. Records are JSON dicts with a nonempty string id. Append exactly one line for a new id and return True. Identical existing record is an idempotent False; same id but changed content raises ValueError. Reconcile all current lines under an exclusive advisory lock, reject existing malformed rows/duplicate ids, accept finite JSON only, append/fsync under lock. Concurrent cooperating processes must never duplicate/lose rows. Failed serialization must not change existing ledger bytes. Do not truncate/repair malformed ledgers. Crash atomicity across power failure is not claimed. Keep under 100 lines, provide the function in the answer, do not edit repo implementation.

synthesis.question: Choose a starting effort policy for a crypto-research repo presently using Astra Ultra everywhere. What can and cannot be concluded without a representative measured comparison? Does project config update an already running task?

source_notes.paraphrase: Effort involves quality, latency and token tradeoffs. Ultra supports automatic delegation; lower adequate effort is preferred. Most tasks do not require the highest efforts.
Trusted project configuration layers over user defaults; runtime/client overrides can take precedence.
